claims.claim: The plugin test suite passes with 0 failures (Hermes Agent v0.23.0 checkout, venv Python 3.11.16, Linux; python-docx installed from a scratch target dir whose path contains site-packages, because the plugin only forwards such sys.path entries to the engine subprocess)
claims.command: pip install --target /tmp/dike-scratch/site-packages 'python-docx>=1.1,<2' && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=/tmp/dike-scratch/site-packages ~/.hermes/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -q -p no:cacheprovider

claims.claim: The panel backend answers estado (installed corpus + pack hash) and verificar (4/6 on the demo brief) when called against the installed package
claims.command: cd $HERMES_HOME/plugins/dike && HERMES_HOME=<profile-home> python -c "import importlib.util,sys; s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('a','dashboard/plugin_api.py'); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); sys.modules[s.name]=m; s.loader.exec_module(m); print(m.estado()); print(m.verificar({'texto': open('tests/fixtures/escrito_demo.md').read()})['meta'])"

claims.claim: hermes plugins validate passes on the 0.7.0 tree (clean copy without desktop/node_modules and .git): declared tools and hooks match registrations, security scan safe, desktop surface inside the SDK
The Desktop pure-logic tests pass (verifier, privacy, chat, NIF proposals, predictor)

On the 456 synthetic documents of the dpp-ai-compliance-lab goldset v0.3.0 (synthetic and synthetic-augmented; the 44 semi-synthetic excluded), the privacy detector in the strict strategy detects with precision 0.9588, recall 1.0, F1 0.979 (detection counts the 271 case anchors RIT/RUC that are detected and kept); counting only what it masks, F1 0.8834; recall 1.0 for RUT, email and phone. The baseline is the uncommitted working tree of dpp-ai-compliance-lab over 0d1e386 (F1 0.9425); 0d1e386 itself scores 0.8078. The goldset has low diversity (16 distinct names, 10 RUT values): it is a regression check, not evidence of generalization.

Two real model turns in the lexo-lawyer profile carrying the <dike-escritor v="1"> envelope (synthetic demo brief; model overridden to an OpenRouter-hosted model for the CLI run): the hook injected the instructions in both, and pre_tool_call blocked the model's attempt to use the terminal; no tool outside the allowlist ran
claims.command: hermes -p lexo-lawyer chat -q "$(cat turno.txt)" -Q  # then read plugin-data/dike/escritor/auditoria.jsonl

claims.claim: Content search over the sealed corpus (POST /grafo/buscar, scripts/panel.py grafo buscar) is a development measurement within the sample: recall@10 0.952, recall@5 0.823, mrr@10 0.636 over the 31 frozen queries of normas_qrels_v1, which cover 4 of the 25 statutes. The qrels were frozen with this same StarterCorpusRetriever and its constants were fixed while looking at the source goldset, so the numbers are not an independent holdout estimate.

The packaged matter tree (data/arbol/, 85 nodes, 51 anchors) explains content-search queries without reordering them: over the same 31 normas_qrels_v1 queries the ranking metrics are unchanged (0.823 / 0.952 / 0.636), the classification is clear (top1/top2 ratio >= 1.6) in 8 of 31, and the top-1 matter's territory contains the statute of an expected article in 14 of 31. It is an explanation of the classification, not a quality improvement.
claims.command: HOME=<generation>/home PYTHONPATH=motor python scripts/medir_busqueda.py --qrels <normas_qrels_v1.json> --corpus <generation>/users/hermes/starter/chile-base/current  # fields clara, materia_top1_cubre_esperado
